authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: User explicitly selects mūrdhan for this reviewed head group on 2026-09-15. Turner records regional mur/muṇḍ head comparanda but explicitly allows derivation from or crossing with muṇḍa shaven for many unaspirated forms. Retain this possible contamination or alternative derivation and local phonetic/transmission uncertainty. Prior hold, now resolved by user choice: CDIAL 10247 mūrdhan expressly says that many unaspirated muṇḍ/muṛ head forms may instead derive from, or be contaminated by, muṇḍa “shaven”. The current forms do not resolve that competing etymon.
